status: Primary specification selected after development diagnostics, before running this new rule. Exploratory development result; not independently selected.

preprocessing.imputation: Finite training median per feature; zero only if entirely missing. Fit separately inside every inner and outer training fold.
preprocessing.quantile_method: linear; computed on training rows after training-only imputation
preprocessing.scaling: Training mean and population standard deviation (ddof=0), after clipping. Apply training bounds, center and scale to validation/current inputs.
preprocessing.disabled_feature: Zero both training and prediction standardized columns; coefficient/contribution exactly zero.

policy.counting: Only finite original source observations whose source date is at or before that row's decision cutoff; each source date counts once per feature. Imputed or carried-forward-only rows do not create observed history.
policy.variation: Observed-only std on unique eligible source snapshots; distinct values are numpy rint(value/0.01) bins. Also require processed training std after imputation/clipping. Thresholds are inclusive.
policy.rationale: Retain the existing twelve-observation sensitivity as a minimum, strengthen it to distinct source snapshots and three distinct one-basis-point bins, and reject sub-one-basis-point standard deviations. One basis point is an explicit economic-resolution engineering choice, not a validated optimum. Rules will not be tuned against development portfolio returns.

ridge.objective: Sum squared loss plus alpha times squared coefficient norm; unpenalized training-target-mean intercept, targets in monthly decimal returns.
ridge.tuning: Same chronological per-asset MSE tuning as clipping-only; inner targets must finish by validation cutoff. Fixed alpha order breaks ties. All preprocessing and policy checks are refit in every fold.

training.inner_first_index_rule: max(24, n_train // 2); embargo incomplete training intervals before each validation decision

portfolio.covariance: Last 36 known calendar-close monthly returns, at least 24; sample covariance.
portfolio.view_uncertainty: Sample variance (ddof=1) of this corrected model's own prior completed forecast errors, at least 12. Recomputed from the start; no original-model error history reused.
portfolio.execution: Decide at 8pm New York on last trading day; enter next trading-day adjusted close, exit next rebalance adjusted close. Continuous holdings with drift and multiplicative trading costs. Initial mix already funded.

forecast_cohorts: all matched forecasts including allocation warm-up
evaluation.numerical_acceptance: Finite forecasts, exact decomposition within 1e-10, no policy contribution when disabled, prior-only preprocessing/target/error timing, reconciled wealth/costs/bounds, zero 20% warning flags over both development cohorts. Failure is reported; no output cap, silent fallback or automatic retuning.
evaluation.forecast_reporting: Per-asset MAE/RMSE, OOS R2 against matched expanding historical mean, largest absolute forecast and warning counts; calendar years and policy activation reasons.
evaluation.predictive_claim_rule: Claim per-asset development improvement only if OOS R2 > 0 and MAE <= expanding historical mean in both cohorts. Report failures explicitly; this is descriptive, not a significance claim.
evaluation.portfolio_reporting: Net cumulative return, daily maximum drawdown, turnover, costs, allocation-limit frequency and calendar-year returns on identical continuous dates. No minimum return target and no selection to restore 23.99%.

reserved_test.rule: Never evaluate in these development commands. Freeze hashes before a separately authorized evaluation; first confirm whether the team has examined this period. Do not retune after seeing reserved results.

data_limitations: Latest revised macro histories and assumed release lags remain; no ALFRED real-time vintage reconstruction. A numerical correction does not cure revised-data bias.
